ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the clock edge for all synchronous processes and sequences in the entity. Drives rising_edge controls in bus_access, transceiver, irq_generator, chip_select and clock_generator and is mapped into instantiated FIFOs.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in processes bus_access, irq_generator, transceiver, chip_select, clock_generator and clk_i => clk_i in FIFO port maps

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Resets registers and outputs to defined values when low. Drives reset branches in all synchronous processes to set control, engine, FIFO-control and clock-generation state.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then branches in processes bus_access, irq_generator, transceiver, chip_select, clock_generator

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Record port declared for bus requests; its individual fields are used throughout the design. The record name itself is not used except in its declaration; fields supply address, control and data to internal logic.
ports.evidence: Only fields of bus_req_i are referenced (bus_req_i.stb, .rw, .addr, .data etc) in source

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Supplies the bus address bits used to select register/file paths. addr(2) gates register read/write paths and selects data returned from FIFOs or control registers.
ports.evidence: bus_access and concurrent assignments use bus_req_i.addr(2) to choose write/read paths and tx/rx FIFO access

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Carries data written by the bus; individual bits are sampled into control fields on write and concatenated to form TX FIFO write words. Also used to form tx_fifo.wdata.
ports.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl fields <= bus_req_i.data(bits); tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(31) & bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the bus request record but not referenced anywhere in this source. No logic in this entity reads or gates on the byte-enable field.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.ben in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates an active bus transaction; it is sampled to generate bus response ack, to gate register writes and FIFO writes/reads, and to control tx/rx FIFO operations.
ports.evidence: bus_access uses if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ...; bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re use bus_req_i.stb in their conditional assignments

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Specifies read (0) or write (1) transactions. Controls whether writes update control registers / TX FIFO or reads return RX FIFO / status.
ports.evidence: bus_access branches on bus_req_i.rw to choose write (rw='1') or read (rw='0') paths; tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re conditions include bus_req_i.rw

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this source; the source field of the bus request does not participate in any logic here.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.src in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared as part of the bus request but not used anywhere in this entity's logic.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.priv in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared but unused in this source; the debug flag does not modify behavior inside this entity.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.debug in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request record but not used by this entity's logic.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.amo in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Part of bus request record but not referenced in this code; no logic depends on the amoop field here.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.amoop in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared but not used in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.lock in the source

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared but not used inside this entity.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.fence in the source

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Collects ack, error and data fields driven by the bus_access clocked process and presented to the bus master. Fields are updated each bus_access cycle from internal state and FIFOs.
role: reports register and FIFO reads to bus master
ports.evidence: bus_access (clocked) assigns bus_rsp_o.ack, .err, .data from bus_req_i.stb, ctrl fields, rx_fifo and tx_fifo signals

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Reports transaction acknowledgement; sampled each cycle from bus_req_i.stb in the bus_access clocked process and exported to the bus master.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb in bus_access (rising_edge(clk_i) branch)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Always driven low by the bus_access process to indicate no error; updated every bus cycle in the clocked process.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in bus_access (rising_edge(clk_i) branch)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Delivers readback data or FIFO byte to the bus master; its bits are populated from control fields, FIFO flags, fifo size constants, cs_active and rx_fifo.rdata depending on address and bus transaction.
role: reports control and FIFO read results
ports.evidence: bus_access assigns various bits of bus_rsp_o.data from ctrl fields and rx_fifo/tx_fifo signals in clocked read path

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Reflects the controller enable bit to the outside world; driven continuously from ctrl.enable and exported as a single-bit output.
ports.evidence: clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable (concurrent assignment at end of architecture)

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Supplies a set of clock-source bits indexed by ctrl.prsc used by the clock generation logic; a selected bit gates the cdiv counter and spi clock enable when high.
role: indexed by prescaler setting to gate clock generation
ports.evidence: clock_generator checks clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) = '1' in conditional that sets spi_clk_en and updates cdiv_cnt

ports.name: spi_clk_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external SPI clock pin from the internal rtx_engine serial clock signal. It is continuously assigned from rtx_engine.sck.
ports.evidence: spi_clk_o <= rtx_engine.sck (concurrent assignment)

ports.name: spi_dat_o
ports.functionality: Drives MOSI from the MSB of the transmit shift register. It is driven continuously from rtx_engine.sreg(7).
ports.evidence: spi_dat_o <= rtx_engine.sreg(7) (concurrent assignment)

ports.name: spi_dat_i
ports.functionality: Samples external MISO and supplies the serial input bit to the transceiver; the bit is synchronously captured into rtx_engine.sdi_sync inside the transceiver process.
ports.evidence: rtx_engine.sdi_sync <= spi_dat_i in transceiver when state = "110"

ports.name: spi_csn_o
ports.functionality: Provides 8 active-low chip-select outputs that are driven each clock cycle; defaulted high and, when cs_ctrl(3)='1', the indexed bit (from rtx_engine.cs_ctrl(2 downto 0)) is driven low to select a slave.
ports.evidence: chip_select process sets spi_csn_o <= (others => '1') and spi_csn_o(to_integer(unsigned(rtx_engine.cs_ctrl(2 downto 0)))) <= '0' when cs_ctrl(3) = '1'

ports.name: irq_o
ports.functionality: Asserts when the controller is enabled and any enabled IRQ condition holds (RX available, TX empty, TX half, or idle). It samples control IRQ enables, fifo flags and rtx_engine.busy each clock and drives the output.
ports.evidence: irq_generator process computes irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_rx_avail and rx_fifo.avail) or ...) on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds multiple SPI control and IRQ-enable fields updated on bus writes. Its fields drive clock generation, transceiver mode and IRQ generation and are captured/written in the bus_access clocked process.
role: provides control inputs to other logic
signals.evidence: bus_access (clocked) assigns ctrl fields <= bus_req_i.data(bits) and reset branch clears ctrl fields

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Enable bit stored in the ctrl register; is written from bus_req_i.data. It gates FIFO clears, clocks (clkgen_en_o), rtx_engine.state(2), and overall IRQ generation and clock generation behavior.
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c); tx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable; clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable; transceiver sets rtx_engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable; clock_generator branches on ctrl.enable

signals.name: ctrl.cpha
signals.functionality: Stored CPHA configuration bit that alters SCK transitions in the transceiver. Written from bus data and used to compute internal sck toggles in transceiver state transitions.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.cpha <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cpha_c); transceiver uses ctrl.cpha in SCK assignments (e.g. if ctrl.cpha = '1' then rtx_engine.sck <= not ctrl.cpol)

signals.name: ctrl.cpol
signals.functionality: Stored CPOL bit that sets idle SCK level and participates in toggles; written from bus and used to initialise and update rtx_engine.sck.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.cpol <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cpol_c); transceiver sets rtx_engine.sck <= ctrl.cpol in several branches

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: 3-bit prescaler index written by the bus; used to index clkgen_i to decide when to advance the divide counter and to derive SPI clock enable.
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c); clock_generator uses clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc)))

signals.name: ctrl.cdiv
signals.functionality: 4-bit divider threshold written via bus; compared against cdiv_cnt to generate spi_clk_en pulses when equality occurs.
role: compares with cdiv_cnt to enable SPI clock
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns ctrl.cdiv <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cdiv3_c downto ctrl_cdiv0_c); clock_generator compares cdiv_cnt = ctrl.cdiv to set spi_clk_en

signals.name: ctrl.highspeed
signals.functionality: When set (written from bus), bypasses clkgen_i gating to allow faster clocking; read by clock_generator to permit spi_clk_en regardless of clkgen_i bit.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.highspeed <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_highspeed_c); clock_generator uses ctrl.highspeed in OR that gates spi_clk_en

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_avail
signals.functionality: Enables IRQ when RX FIFO has available data; written via bus and used in irq_generator to contribute to irq_o when both enabled and rx_fifo.avail are high.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.irq_rx_avail <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_avail_c); irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_rx_avail and rx_fifo.avail

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_empty
signals.functionality: When set via bus write, enables IRQ when TX FIFO is empty. Used in irq_generator combined with tx_fifo.avail inversion to assert irq_o.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.irq_tx_empty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_empty_c); irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_tx_empty and not tx_fifo.avail

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf
signals.functionality: Enables IRQ when TX FIFO is not at half level; stored from bus writes and used in irq logic with tx_fifo.half.
role: gates irq_o on TX half condition
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_nhalf_c); irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf and not tx_fifo.half

signals.name: ctrl.irq_idle
signals.functionality: Enables IRQ for idle condition (TX empty and engine not busy). Written by bus and polled in irq_generator combined with tx_fifo.avail and rtx_engine.busy.
signals.evidence: bus_access writes ctrl.irq_idle <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_idle_c); irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_idle and (not tx_fifo.avail) and (not rtx_engine.busy)

signals.name: cdiv_cnt
signals.functionality: Counts clock pulses under control of clkgen/prsc/highspeed and resets when equals ctrl.cdiv; when equal it asserts spi_clk_en and resets. It increments each gated clock cycle.
signals.evidence: clock_generator compares if (cdiv_cnt = ctrl.cdiv) then spi_clk_en <= '1'; else cdiv_cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(cdiv_cnt)+1)

signals.name: spi_clk_en
signals.functionality: One-cycle pulse asserted when cdiv_cnt equals ctrl.cdiv (or highspeed), cleared each clock; used as gate in transceiver state machine to advance SCK and sampling/shift operations.
signals.evidence: clock_generator sets spi_clk_en <= '1' when cdiv_cnt = ctrl.cdiv; transceiver checks if (spi_clk_en = '1') then ... in several states

signals.name: rtx_engine
signals.functionality: Bundle of state, shift register, counters and control bits for SPI transmission; fields are synchronously updated in the transceiver process and control FIFO read/write and CS outputs.
signals.evidence: transceiver (clocked) assigns many rtx_engine fields from tx_fifo.rdata and from internal signals

signals.name: rtx_engine.state
signals.functionality: 3-bit state register controlling the transceiver state machine. state(2) is driven by ctrl.enable and the lower bits are set in the state machine to sequence TX/RX operations and to select FIFO reads.
signals.evidence: transceiver sets rtx_engine.state bits in case rtx_engine.state is ...; tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (rtx_engine.state = "100")

signals.name: rtx_engine.busy
signals.functionality: Combinational signal derived from state low bits indicating whether the engine is active. It is assigned from rtx_engine.state and read by bus_access and irq logic to indicate busy status.
role: reports engine activity to IRQ and status
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.busy <= '0' when (rtx_engine.state(1 downto 0) = "00") else '1'; bus_access reads rtx_engine.busy for ctrl_busy_c and irq_generator uses rtx_engine.busy

signals.name: rtx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: 8-bit shift register holding transmit data; loaded from tx_fifo.rdata or shifted in from sdi_sync and its MSB drives MOSI and RX FIFO write data.
role: provides MOSI and RX FIFO payload
signals.evidence: transceiver loads rtx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0) or shifts in sdi_sync; spi_dat_o <= rtx_engine.sreg(7); rx_fifo.wdata <= '0' & rtx_engine.sreg

signals.name: rtx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: 4-bit counter incremented each bit clock to track transmitted bits; its MSB is tested to detect end-of-byte and to set done and state transitions.
signals.evidence: transceiver increments rtx_engine.bitcnt and tests rtx_engine.bitcnt(3) = '1' to set done and change state

signals.name: rtx_engine.sdi_sync
signals.functionality: Single-bit register capturing the sampled MISO bit (from spi_dat_i) and later shifted into sreg. It is captured in the '110' state and consumed in '111'.
signals.evidence: transceiver assigns rtx_engine.sdi_sync <= spi_dat_i in state "110"; later rtx_engine.sreg <= rtx_engine.sreg(6 downto 0) & rtx_engine.sdi_sync

signals.name: rtx_engine.sck
signals.functionality: Internal serial clock signal for SPI, driven by FSM using ctrl.cpol and ctrl.cpha and toggles when spi_clk_en pulses. It is exported to spi_clk_o.
signals.evidence: transceiver sets rtx_engine.sck to ctrl.cpol or toggled expressions (ctrl.cpha xor ctrl.cpol) when spi_clk_en = '1'; spi_clk_o <= rtx_engine.sck

signals.name: rtx_engine.cs_ctrl
signals.functionality: 4-bit field holding chip-select control loaded from a control word in the TX FIFO when rdata(8)='1'. cs_ctrl(3) indicates active selection and lower bits index which CS to assert low.
signals.evidence: transceiver sets rtx_engine.cs_ctrl <= tx_fifo.rdata(3 downto 0) when tx_fifo.rdata(8) = '1'; chip_select uses rtx_engine.cs_ctrl to index spi_csn_o

signals.name: rtx_engine.done
signals.functionality: One-cycle flag asserted when a byte transfer completes; produced in FSM and used to write the received byte into RX FIFO (rx_fifo.we). It is cleared each clock by the FSM start of cycle.
signals.evidence: transceiver sets rtx_engine.done <= '1' when rtx_engine.bitcnt(3) = '1' in state "111"; rx_fifo.we <= rtx_engine.done

signals.name: tx_fifo
signals.functionality: Aggregate of control signals interfacing the instantiated transmit FIFO: we, re, wdata, rdata, avail, free, clear, half. Some fields are written combinationally here; others are outputs from the FIFO instance.
role: connects instantiated FIFO to engine and bus
signals.evidence: tx_fifo fields are driven by concurrent assignments and FIFO instance port map (tx_fifo_inst)

signals.name: tx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Asserted combinationally when a bus write to the TX FIFO address occurs (bus_req_i.stb=1, rw=1, addr(2)=1). Enables FIFO write of tx_fifo.wdata.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Combinational read request to the TX FIFO asserted when the engine state equals "100" to pop the next TX word for transmission.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (rtx_engine.state = "100") else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: 9-bit write word formed by concatenating the top bus data bit and the low byte of bus_req_i.data. Presented to FIFO on bus writes when tx_fifo.we is asserted.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(31) & bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

signals.name: tx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: 9-bit word read from the TX FIFO instance; its MSB indicates a control-word vs data, its low 4 bits may select CS, and low byte is transmit payload. Consumed by the transceiver FSM.
role: provides control or data to engine
signals.evidence: transceiver inspects tx_fifo.rdata(8) and either loads cs_ctrl <= tx_fifo.rdata(3 downto 0) or sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0)

signals.name: tx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Output from the TX FIFO instance indicating data availability. Read by the engine to decide whether to pop data, by bus_access for status bits and by irq logic.
role: feeds engine, status and IRQ logic
signals.evidence: transceiver checks if (tx_fifo.avail = '1') then ...; bus_access and irq_generator read tx_fifo.avail

signals.name: tx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Output from the FIFO instance indicating free status; used in bus_access to report tx_full status (inverted) to bus reads.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.free connected from FIFO instance and bus_access uses not tx_fifo.free to set ctrl_tx_full_c bit

signals.name: tx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinational control that clears the TX FIFO when the controller is disabled (not ctrl.enable). Driven here as an immediate inversion of ctrl.enable.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: tx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Output from the FIFO instance indicating half-full status; read in status reads and used by IRQ logic (inverted for tx_nhalf).
signals.evidence: bus_access uses not tx_fifo.half for ctrl_tx_nhalf_c; irq_generator uses not tx_fifo.half with ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf

signals.name: rx_fifo
signals.functionality: Aggregate of the RX FIFO interface signals: we, re, wdata, rdata, avail, free, clear, half. Fields connect the instantiated RX FIFO to the engine and bus logic.
role: connects instantiated RX FIFO to engine and bus
signals.evidence: rx_fifo fields are driven by concurrent assignments and the FIFO instance port map (rx_fifo_inst)

signals.name: rx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Asserted from rtx_engine.done to push received byte into RX FIFO when a transfer completes. This is a direct connection from the engine completion flag.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.we <= rtx_engine.done (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: rx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Combinational read request to the RX FIFO asserted on a bus read to the RX data address (bus_req_i.stb=1, rw=0, addr(2)=1).
role: drives FIFO output to bus read
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

signals.name: rx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: 9-bit write word provided to RX FIFO consisting of a leading zero and the current rtx_engine.sreg contents; used when rtx_engine.done asserts.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= '0' & rtx_engine.sreg (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: rx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: 9-bit word output from RX FIFO instance; low 8 bits are presented to bus reads via bus_rsp_o.data when appropriate.
signals.evidence: bus_access assigns bus_rsp_o.data(7 downto 0) <= rx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0) on read path

signals.name: rx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Indicates RX FIFO contains data; used by bus status readback and by irq_generator to create RX-available IRQ when enabled.
signals.evidence: bus_access reads rx_fifo.avail for ctrl_rx_avail_c; irq_generator uses rx_fifo.avail and ctrl.irq_rx_avail

signals.name: rx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Provided by FIFO instance (unused in combinational logic here except available as a port); not used elsewhere in this source for decision logic.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.free is connected in FIFO port map but not read in this architecture

signals.name: rx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinational clear input for RX FIFO driven as the inverse of ctrl.enable to flush RX FIFO when controller disabled.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable (concurrent assignment)

signals.name: rx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Half-full indicator from the RX FIFO instance; available for status reads but not used elsewhere in this code.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.half connected from FIFO port map; no explicit use in architecture
